ai.rationale: Exceptional submission. Contrarian pedagogical framing — "AI tutors as question-asking architecture, not answer machines" — backed by a concrete 2-round structure: athlete states intent, attempts on video, predicts AI feedback, then sees a Socratic question with a cited still-frame; round 2 measures whether round-1 focus was actually addressed. Sport-specific (boxing technique), all three URLs filled (Loom + repo + Streamlit deploy), explicit AI leverage (OpenAI + multimodal video reasoning), and grounded in a named learning-design framework. This is the kind of sharp, well-developed thinking that's hard to fake in one day.
